chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

There is no thing except that it has a measure and a weight, except for the tears, for the drop can extinguish an ocean of fire. So when the eye overflows with its water, neither will its face be burdened with darkness nor humiliation. So when they overflow, Allah prohibits them upon the Fire, and if a weeper were to weep in a community, they would be shown mercy.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of weeping in Shia Islam according to the hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the unique spiritual weight of tears, contrasting them with all other created things that are bound by specific measures and weights. He emphasizes that sincere weeping, whether for personal repentance or communal grief, acts as a divine extinguisher of Hellfire and a shield against the humiliation of the Day of Judgment, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the purifying power of emotional devotion (khushu').

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There is none from the things except that there is a measurement and a weight for it, except for the tears, for the drop can extinguish an ocean of fire. So when the eyes are overflowing by its water, neither will its face wear out nor be disgraced. So when they overflow, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Prohibits it upon the Fire, and if a weeper were to weep in a community, it would be Shown Mercy’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mansur ibn Yunus from Muhammad ibn Marwan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

For everything there is weighing and measuring except tears. One drop of tears can extinguish oceans of fire. If the eyes flood with tears the face will not suffer hardships and humiliation. When tears flow out, Allah makes it forbidden for the fire and if a person weeps in a nation, such nation will receive favors.”
